public.text: Line 293 states strategic governance "does not manage operations," but the "Securing financial continuity" and "Managing demand on shared capacity" subsections assign it operational-sounding actions (monitor utilisation against capacity, adjust fee structures, monitoring and reporting of utilisation patterns), contradicting the stated separation.
public.suggestedRevision: Reframe these actions as strategic-level authority exercised on operationally-supplied data or explicitly note that strategic bodies set the parameters that operational governance then applies.
